observations: The microwave has a black door with a glass window and a handle on the left side.
The control panel is black with white lettering and two dials: one for power levels (Low, Med, High, M.Low, M.High) and one for timer (0-35 minutes) and defrost weight (0-6 kg).
The unit appears to be placed on a wooden surface or stand, with a tiled wall in the background.
There is visible wear and smudges on the control panel and the top surface of the microwave.
The door has a metal rack inside, and the interior appears clean.
No power cord or plug is visible in any photo.
The seller claims it is 'barely used' and 'bought new last year'.

claims.claim: Barely used. Had bigger alternatives so didn't quite use this one much.
claims.evidence: Photos show no signs of heavy use, but no proof of usage history. The unit appears clean, but wear is visible on the top surface and control panel.

claims.claim: Bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The microwave may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the microwave turning on, heating a cup of water, and rotating the turntable.

risks.risk: The power cord or plug may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: Photo of the power cord and plug.

risks.risk: The interior or door seal may be damaged or worn, affecting performance or safety.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the door seal and interior walls.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially unsafe or inefficient

proof_requests: Video of the microwave in operation, heating water and rotating the turntable.
Photo of the power cord and plug.
Close-up photo of the door seal and interior walls.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
